description:
Activate Urza by tapping Unctus, adding {U}.
Activate Unctus by paying {U/P}, causing Fallowsage to become an artifact until end of turn.
Activate Urza by tapping Fallowsage, adding {U}.
Fallowsage triggers, causing you to draw two cards and discard a card.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Fallowsage.
Repeat.
